description: Save a past story or memory as a private moment. Plans go to log_event; a touchpoint with a contact to log_interaction. Requires title, and moment_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; alias date) unless event_id is given. With event_id (an owned event the story is about) it creates a NEW moment linked to that event and takes the event's date and location when you pass none; the event itself is never changed, converted or deleted, and one event can have many moments. Don't also save the story as an event. Optional: description (the longer story), moment_date_precision (exact, month, year, circa), end_date, moment_type (default memory), location_name (only a place the user said), person_ids (owned contacts; any other id saves nothing), people_names (tag saved contacts only, never created), cover_image_url / media_urls (https links), tags. Always private: there is no visibility argument; the owner shares a moment in Dayze. Fix it later with update_moment. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write. ($0.10; API key required)

cover_image_url.description: Optional https image link for the moment's cover.

description.description: The longer story, in the user's words where possible.

end_date.description: Optional last day YYYY-MM-DD, for a moment that spans days.

event_id.description: A calendar event this story is about (owned). Links the new moment to it; the event is not changed.

location_name.description: Where it happened, only as the user said it. With event_id and no place, the event's location is used. Alias: location.

moment_date.description: When it happened: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY (alias date). With event_id and no date, the event's date is used. Otherwise required.

moment_date_precision.description: How exact the date is. YYYY-MM and YYYY default to month and year; circa for "around then".

people_names.description: Names the user said; tagged only when they match a saved contact (never created). Unmatched names come back in unresolved_people.

person_ids.description: Owned contact ids of people in the story (max 25). An id that isn't the user's saves nothing.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

title.description: The story in a few words (max 200), e.g. "Mia called the moon a banana".

name: log_moment

inherited_from_event.description: moment_date and/or location_name, when taken from the linked event.

linked_event.description: The event this moment links, unchanged by the call; null when none.

moment.description: A moment: a story or memory, private to the owner. event_id links the event it is about.

moment_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (the first day of the month or year for a soft date).

visibility.description: Always private for a moment an agent saves.

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

unresolved_people.description: people_names that matched no saved contact (not tagged, not created).

title: Log Moment (story or memory)
